local_review.finding_body:
FS-contribution-contract.2 limits this new-library contribution to the Spring Cloud Consul coordinate; routed owner metadata may add entries but may not remove or change existing entries. The branch modifies metadata/org.hibernate.validator/hibernate-validator/7.0.4.Final/reachability-metadata.json, and local gate evidence records that path in repo_fix_paths with human_intervention_required=true. Restoring the shared file and running the required finalization command makes the GraalVM 25 lane fail in nativeTestCompile with `Type not found during analysis: org.hibernate.validator.internal.constraintvalidators.bv.time.past.PastValidatorForReadablePartial`; the latest current-defaults and future-defaults lanes pass. Fixing this requires shared Hibernate Validator metadata rather than a target-coordinate repair.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/11046 (#11046)
local_review.finding_title: Spring validation dependency requires an out-of-scope Hibernate Validator metadata correction
local_review.fix_note: Restored the unauthorized Hibernate Validator metadata file to the base revision to verify whether the contribution could stand alone. The required finalization run then reproduced the shared metadata failure, so no target-coordinate workaround was added.
local_review.review_comment:
The target tests are public, library-specific, version-agnostic, in a separate package, bounded by valid timeouts, and run the same behavior on JVM and Native Image. The contribution uses only reachability-metadata.json, and the reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is valid. Index validation passed. However, the branch changes Hibernate Validator metadata outside the target coordinate. After restoring that file to the base revision, the exact finalization command passed both latest-GraalVM lanes but failed the GraalVM 25 native-image build on an absent optional Hibernate Validator type. This is a shared metadata defect and requires maintainer intervention under FS-contribution-contract.5.3 and 5.5.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/11046 (#11046)
